notes: All 15 upscaled inputs matched raw-assets/photos/upscaled/manifest.json (sha256, bytes, pixel size). Single-file test (p1-farmers, nonla-slight.json, q92 progressive) -> valid JPEG 3258x2160; the script's p1-farmers output is byte-identical to it (sha256 c517416b...), so the recipe params reach photocraft-cli intact and the edit is deterministic. Fixed photocraft/run_slight_edit.ps1 for Windows PowerShell 5.1: (1) 5.1 strips unescaped double quotes from native-command args, so photocraft-cli got {temperature:8,...} and exited 2; params are now escaped as \" when $PSNativeCommandArgumentPassing is not Standard/Windows (no-op on PowerShell 7.3+). (2) manifest.json is now written UTF-8 without BOM and with LF (Set-Content -Encoding utf8 in 5.1 adds a BOM, which JSON.parse rejects). Ran as `powershell -NoProfile -File photocraft\run_slight_edit.ps1` from the repo root: `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` was refused by the PC's permission classifier and is unnecessary here (LocalMachine policy is Unrestricted, script has no Zone.Identifier). 15/15 edited at the same pixel sizes as their inputs; recipes: nonla-slight x13, nonla-slight-denoise (p2-chin-straps), nonla-slight-nosharpen (p3-poem). Spot-checked p2-chin-straps (3240x2160) and p3-poem (2160x2160) with photocraft-cli info: 8-bit RGB, 1 layer. Visual before/after of p1-farmers and p2-chin-straps: slight warmth/lift, no clipping.
